questions.text: A circle centered at the origin is tangent to the parabola \(y^2=8x\). Find the radius of the circle.
The parabola \(x^2=4py\) and the circle \(x^2+(y-3)^2=9\) intersect in exactly one point. Find \(p\).
A point \(P\) lies on the parabola \(y^2=12x\). The distance from \(P\) to the focus equals \(10\). Find the coordinates of \(P\).
Two parabolas share the same vertex at the origin: \(x^2=4ay\) and \(y^2=4ax\), where \(a>0\). Find the area enclosed by their arcs.
A circle centered at \((2,0)\) passes through the focus of the parabola \(y^2=8x\) and is tangent to its directrix. Find the equation of the circle.

Let \(P\) be a point on the parabola \(x^2=4y\). A line through \(P\) with slope \(1\) meets the directrix at \(A\) and the \(y\)-axis at \(B\). Find the value of \(AB\), independent of the choice of \(P\).

questions.source_label: Chapter 11.1 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q1
questions.text: A circle is tangent to the line $y = -4$ and passes through the point $(0, 4)$. As the circle's size and position vary, its center traces out a curve with the equation $y = ax^2$. Find the exact value of $a$.

questions.source_label: Chapter 11.1 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q2
questions.text: A circle is constructed such that the latus rectum of the parabola $y^2 = 28x$ serves as its diameter. Find the $(x, y)$ coordinates of the point(s) where this circle intersects the parabola's directrix.

questions.source_label: Chapter 11.1 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q3
questions.text: A line with a positive slope passes through the origin and intersects the parabola $x^2 = 8y$ at a second point $P$. If the distance from $P$ to the parabola's focus is exactly 10, what is the slope of the line?

questions.source_label: Chapter 11.1 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q4
questions.text: A circle is centered at the focus of the parabola $y = \frac{1}{12}x^2$ and is tangent to its directrix. What is the straight-line distance between the two points where this circle intersects the parabola?

questions.source_label: Chapter 11.1 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q5
questions.text: A line segment passes through the focus of the parabola $x^2 = 24y$, with both of its endpoints lying on the parabola. If one endpoint is exactly 18 units away from the parabola's directrix, what is the exact distance from the other endpoint to the directrix?

questions.source_label: Chapter 11.1 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q6
questions.text: The parabola $y^2 = cx$ (where $c > 0$) and the circle $x^2 + y^2 = 80$ intersect at exactly two points. If the straight-line distance between these two intersection points is equal to the focal diameter of the parabola, what is the value of $c$?
